2609.02451.title: Scalable Kronecker-Fisher Approximation: Efficient Hessian Analysis for Billion-Parameter Language Models Compression
2609.02451.paper_summary: In this paper, we propose a scalable Kronecker-based approximation that captures cross-layer interactions without storing the entire Fisher matrix, enabling practical Hessian analysis for billion-parameter networks where full computation is infeasible. Our approach reveals consistent vulnerability patterns: value projection layers exhibit the highest sensitivity and strongest cross-layer correlations across multiple model families, while other components exhibit architecture-specific behaviors. Through extensive experiments on quantization, sparsification, inter-layer corruption, and post-corruption fine-tuning, we demonstrate that our approximation strongly correlates with both performance degradation and recovery. Our framework provides a practical, theoretically grounded tool for identifying fragile components in large models, opening new avenues for guided compression and optimization strategies, such as mixed-precision allocation, layer-wise sparsity, and adaptive low-rank decomposition across layers and even individual weight groups.
2609.02451.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們提出了一種可擴展的基於克羅內克的近似方法，能夠捕捉跨層互動而無需存儲整個費舍爾矩陣，從而實現對於十億參數網絡的實用海森分析，因為完整計算是不可行的。我們的方法揭示了一致的脆弱性模式：值投影層在多個模型家族中表現出最高的敏感性和最強的跨層相關性，而其他組件則展現出特定於架構的行為。通過對量化、稀疏化、層間腐敗和後腐敗微調的廣泛實驗，我們證明了我們的近似與性能下降和恢復之間存在強相關性。我們的框架提供了一種實用的、理論基礎的工具，用於識別大型模型中的脆弱組件，開啟了指導壓縮和優化策略的新途徑，例如混合精度分配、層級稀疏性以及跨層甚至單個權重組的自適應低秩分解。
